biological_unit: Root cementum–PDL–alveolar bone plus gingiva and pulp
repair_class: Local progenitor-seeded or cell-free interface guidance; position correction and temporary support measured separately
coverage_chain: Cell identity → root/socket access → survival → fiber insertion at both interfaces → force-bearing response → position after support removal
functional_gate: Native-like displacement and toughness; inserted fibers; no ankylosis/resorption; stable intended position
competing_failure: Stiff bone bridge; loose scar; attachment at wrong position; root/pulp injury
denominators_to_keep_separate: Cells present; root area covered; functional PDL area; teeth at target position
next_discriminating_test: Compare seeded and cell-free root-mimetic repair under matched cyclic load with blinded histology, mobility, toughness, pulp and post-support position
evidence_status: Rat attachment proof-of-concept; no human in-situ trauma repositioning method established

biological_unit: Oral epithelium, connective tissue, vasculature and tooth-adjacent attachment
repair_class: Epithelial/connective-tissue co-culture and local progenitor support
coverage_chain: Target zone reached → survival → perfusion → barrier continuity → contour integration → inflammation control
functional_gate: Stable margin, papilla and volume with sealed barrier and low recurrent inflammation
competing_failure: Coverage without attachment; recession; pocketing; scar; chronic inflammation
denominators_to_keep_separate: Cells in graft; surface area covered; intact barrier
next_discriminating_test: Qualify healthy/periodontitis donor maps; test organotypic barrier under microbial and mechanical challenge
evidence_status: Research design; no run-specific efficacy measurement

biological_unit: Pulp vasculature, innervation, odontoblast lineage and dentin interface
repair_class: Vascularized pulp-like construct or recruited dental pulp progenitors
coverage_chain: Correct cell source → perfusion → sensory integration → odontoblast function → maintained vitality
functional_gate: Viable perfused pulp with sensory function and appropriate reparative dentin, without obstructive calcification
competing_failure: Necrosis; ectopic mineralization; absent sensation; pulp-space obliteration
denominators_to_keep_separate: Viable cells; perfused volume; innervated volume; functional dentin response
next_discriminating_test: Compare pulp organoid/vascular co-culture to injury controls with perfusion, neural response and dentin assays
evidence_status: Replantation source reports pulpal calcification as an unresolved risk

biological_unit: Tooth bud lineages, enamel, dentin, cementum, PDL, pulp and jaw socket
repair_class: Developmentally staged tooth organoid or bioengineered tooth germ
coverage_chain: Lineage ratio → spatial organization → mineral maturation → root/PDL interface → eruption/occlusion → durability
functional_gate: Whole-tooth geometry and identity with load-bearing attachment, vitality, occlusion and wear resistance
competing_failure: Malformed crown/root; absent enamel; ankylosis; poor occlusion; missing perfusion or innervation
denominators_to_keep_separate: Organoid count; mineralized organoid count; complete tooth; functionally integrated tooth
next_discriminating_test: Test root/PDL/socket integration separately from crown mineralization and stage-match developmental controls
evidence_status: Research design; organoid phenotype alone is not tooth replacement

biological_unit: Adult fibroblast, epithelial, endothelial and resident immune compartments
repair_class: Cell-state restoration, matrix turnover, localized replacement or niche repair
coverage_chain: Target compartment reached → correct cells engaged → adult identity retained → matrix rebuilt → mechanics/barrier restored
functional_gate: Organ-specific barrier, strength, perfusion and repair after treatment withdrawal
competing_failure: Young-looking transcript panel with identity loss, fibrosis, proliferation or no mechanical gain
denominators_to_keep_separate: Biomarker-positive cells; lineage-retaining cells; repaired area; tissue function
next_discriminating_test: Freeze age and identity signatures in independent tissue cohorts, then link to construct mechanics or barrier function
evidence_status: Current fibroblast analysis: weak broad age-direction transfer in two successful endpoint lines; no organ function tested

biological_unit: Myofiber, satellite cell, tendon fibroblast, enthesis and motor unit
repair_class: Niche restoration, cell replacement or spatial interface reconstruction
coverage_chain: Cell delivery → lineage survival → motor-unit integration → force transmission → repeated-load recovery
functional_gate: Strength, fatigue resistance and coordinated movement after intervention withdrawal
competing_failure: Fibrosis; ectopic mineralization; force without coordination; loss of repair reserve
denominators_to_keep_separate: Edited/engrafted cells; repaired fibers; force-producing volume; coordinated function
next_discriminating_test: Use innervated organotypic co-culture with cyclic loading before organism-level validation
evidence_status: Framework only; not assessed in this run

biological_unit: Organ-specific parenchymal/support cells, vasculature and immune niche
repair_class: Localized replacement, niche repair, organoid/implant or lesion-specific repair
coverage_chain: Compartment reached → target engagement → surviving correct lineage → vascular/duct integration → function and reserve
functional_gate: Tissue-specific filtration, clearance, synthesis or reserve under challenge and after treatment ends
competing_failure: Marker shift without function; unperfused implant; off-target editing; clonal growth; reserve loss
denominators_to_keep_separate: Target engagement; edited-cell fraction; integrated tissue fraction; organ reserve
next_discriminating_test: Connect each organoid assay to a defined organ-level function before inferring systemic rejuvenation
evidence_status: Framework only; requires organ-specific data and function

biological_unit: Neurons, glia, vasculature, synapses and learned circuit organization
repair_class: Selective repair or replacement that preserves network architecture and memory-relevant information
coverage_chain: Cell access → intended-cell engagement → genomic integrity → circuit integration → preserved cognition and learned function
functional_gate: Stable cognition, memory, sensory processing and behavior, not only young molecular markers
competing_failure: Loss of learned organization; network dysfunction; dedifferentiation; tumorigenesis; inflammation
denominators_to_keep_separate: Edited neurons; surviving fraction; integrated circuit fraction; preserved learned behavior
next_discriminating_test: Require pre/post circuit and behavior endpoints with lineage and safety monitoring before broad replacement
evidence_status: Framework only; no neural intervention assessed

biological_unit: Named dysfunctional populations in a declared tissue and disease context
repair_class: Selective removal, cellular repair or immune/niche modulation
coverage_chain: Cell identity → compartment access → selective engagement → useful-cell preservation → niche recovery → function
functional_gate: Lower pathological burden with maintained repair reserve and tissue function
competing_failure: Nonselective depletion; compensatory inflammation; immune impairment; incomplete recovery
denominators_to_keep_separate: Cells engaged; dysfunctional cells removed/repaired; healthy cells preserved; organ function
next_discriminating_test: Use lineage-resolved models with inflammatory and functional endpoints, not one bulk marker
evidence_status: Framework only; no universal senescence target assumed

biological_unit: Specified lesion in a specified organ-specific cell population
repair_class: Base/prime editing, gene correction, selected damage repair or cell replacement
coverage_chain: Target cell reached → intracellular activity → intended-only product → survival → integration → function
functional_gate: Causal lesion corrected in enough relevant cells, with off-target and clone monitoring
competing_failure: Wrong causal target; bystander edits; toxic delivery; clonal selection; molecular correction without benefit
denominators_to_keep_separate: Allele fraction; intended-cell edit fraction; surviving fraction; functional tissue fraction
next_discriminating_test: Name causal mechanism and target denominator before calculating coverage thresholds
evidence_status: Framework only; no universal distributed-aging edit set identified
